nodes.description: Public uint32 tax precision denominator (100000), used to compute tax ratios.
Public address[] list of tax recipient wallets.
Public uint16 cumulative tax amount across all recipients.
Public bool flag indicating whether tax is applied on transfers.
Mapping of recipient address to its individual uint16 tax amount.
Private mapping marking addresses that are tax recipients.
Public mapping of addresses exempt from tax.
Private uint256 max token supply set in constructor and minted to deployer.
LOCKER constructor: sets _totalSupply and mints entire supply to msg.sender.
Overridden ERC20 transferFrom applying tax logic and whitelist checks.
Overridden ERC20 transfer applying tax logic and whitelist checks.
Public burn that destroys tokens from msg.sender without access control.
onlyOwner function toggling the _taxActive flag.
onlyOwner function adding a taxed wallet with a tax amount; updates _taxTotal.
onlyOwner function updating an existing recipient's tax amount and _taxTotal.
onlyOwner function removing a recipient from the tax list and adjusting _taxTotal.
onlyOwner function adding an address to the tax whitelist.
onlyOwner function removing an address from the tax whitelist.
onlyOwner function resetting all tax state to initial values.
onlyOwner function transferring collected tax balance to recipients proportionally.
Caller-controlled address used as spender/owner and for minting and burning.
_transfer(from, address(this), tax) inside transferFrom moving tax to the contract.
_burn(msg.sender, value) allowing any caller to destroy their own tokens.
Tax computation amount * _taxTotal / _taxPercision in transferFrom (arithmetic).
_taxTotal = _taxTotal + _tax uint16 addition in addTaxRecipient (arithmetic).
_taxTotal = _taxTotal - _tax uint16 subtraction in removeTaxRecipient (arithmetic).
_transfer(address(this), taxAddress, amount) loop in distributeTaxes paying out tax balance.
